**Important — do NOT post private or third-party credentials:**

- No portal URLs (server addresses ending in `/c/`), no IP addresses of portal servers
- No MAC addresses (`00:1A:79:**:**:**`)
- No usernames, passwords, or expired/active subscription data

These identify IPTV services and their subscribers. Reports containing them will be redacted. If you must show what you pasted into stbcheck, replace them with placeholders like `[redacted portal]` / `00:1A:79:**:**:**` — the detection logic works the same either way.
